provider: Freelancer.com OAuth2 (developers.freelancer.com; SDK Session requires user-consented token)
refresh_reason: no client credentials, no refresh token, no prior grant stored anywhere authorized
auto_reason: consent requires human browser login + MFA on founder-owned account; no mechanism exists to initiate it headlessly

steps: log in to Freelancer.com in your browser
open developers.freelancer.com and register/authorize the app
add line FREELANCER_OAUTH_TOKEN=<token> to C:\openclaw-dasgboard\.env (terminal or editor on that machine; never chat/email)
founder_action.why: platform requires the account owner to consent; factory holds no account and must never handle your password/MFA
founder_action.unlocks: 4 guarded proposals auto-submit + buyer inbox monitoring + reply loop, all automatically
founder_action.after: no further action needed from you for these 4 opportunities
